points.text: Online sales are distance (通訊) transactions, since you can't inspect the goods first.
You may cancel within 7 days of receipt, by returning goods or written notice, without giving reasons or paying anything.
Exceptions: perishables, custom goods, newspapers, opened media or software, digital content, opened hygiene items, international flights.
An exception applies only if the seller told you it excludes the 7-day right.
If the seller didn't give you the cancellation information, the 7 days start only from when it's provided, up to a 4-month limit.
The contract is treated as cancelled once you ship the goods back or send written notice within the period.

consequences.text: Seller must refund what you paid within 15 days of getting the goods back or your notice.
Seller must collect the goods within 15 days of your written notice, unless otherwise individually negotiated.
Any contract term less favorable to you than the Civil Code restoration rules is void.

next: Send written notice of cancellation within 7 days of receipt
Keep proof of shipping and the notice
Ask for a refund within 15 days
Check the order page for any stated exception
